_doc: Manifest of the real/cross-tool reference corpus (docs/VERIFICATION_PLAN.md, Phase 2). The image FILES live in tests/corpus/ which is gitignored (copyright); this manifest (sha256 + provenance) is the in-repo truth so third parties can re-acquire and verify the corpus. Entries with origin='real' rate a format T1, origin='cross-tool' rate T1b — in both cases only if the named ctest test exists and consumes the image. Consumed by scripts/gen_verification_tiers.py.

_entry_schema.sha256: hex digest of the image file
_entry_schema.origin: 'real' (hardware dump / original file) or 'cross-tool' (produced by a canonical third-party tool)
_entry_schema.tool: producing tool + version for cross-tool entries (e.g. 'VICE 3.8 c1541')
_entry_schema.source: provenance: where/how the image was obtained or generated (reproducible for cross-tool)
_entry_schema.test: ctest test name that opens this image through the UFT plugin
